spec.headline: Paid Search Account Strategy | Client Insights | Testing & Optimization
spec.headline_rationale: Monks needs Google/Bing client management, KPI improvement, PMax, testing and recommendations. Emphasize verified agency account management, bid experiments, reporting and coaching/process building without inventing formal QBR history.
spec.summary: Paid search practitioner with agency portfolio experience and a strong focus on client goals. Managed more than 75 Google Ads accounts, advised clients on campaign structure and budget allocation, and developed an account-management system adopted across the agency. Analyzed smart bidding, incremental CPA, Performance Max and Shopping, and tested keywords, audiences and conversion paths. Combines clear reporting, competitive research and cross-functional collaboration to turn campaign data into practical recommendations and measurable optimization priorities.
spec.factual_review: Read exact Monks Senior Account Manager SEM posting, including conditional RTO clause. Supported E075/E076/E081/E002/E003/E006/E078/E079/E095; do not invent feed-management results, QBR cadence or specific client industries. Existing remote qualification preserved.
spec.tools_rationale: Source-backed paid search execution, analytical and reporting tools aligned to client KPI work.
